chain_words.nuance: a lack of interest or emotional involvement
tiredness of spirit caused by something lasting too long
a common feeling of having nothing engaging to do
dulled interest caused by too much of the same thing
a complete lack of energy or enthusiasm

explanation: These words all describe a lack of engagement, moving from mild indifference to a complete loss of energy and interest.

usage_notes.difference: 'Bored' describes the feeling of having nothing interesting to do; 'jaded' describes a longer-lasting dullness caused by having experienced too much of something.
